D3.empty.reason: The array is empty, as required when no observable action and result are supplied.

D3.grounded.reason: No drafts introduce unsupported measurable behaviour, features or values.

D1.zero.reason: The empty-name case submits the form and expects the required validation error without saving.

D1.one.reason: The minimum-length case submits the supplied value and checks its unchanged appearance in the list.

D1.forty.reason: The maximum-length case submits the supplied repeated-character value and checks its unchanged appearance in the list.

D1.forty_one.reason: The over-limit case submits the supplied value and expects the required validation error without saving.

D1.usable.reason: Each case provides numbered steps, a fresh form with valid remaining fields, and an observable result consistent with submission.

D1.grounded.reason: All values, expected behaviours and criterion associations follow the supplied boundary requirement.
